title: The Election Commission Filed 16 Lakh Appeals Against Included Bengal Voters Over Just 3 Days as the Rolls Froze
shows: It reads the appeal records for West Bengal and finds the Commission appealed against 16,08,175 of the 32,53,401 voters the judges had cleared, or 49.4%. About 99% of the appeal records carry timestamps of 5, 6 or 8 April, and more than 12 lakh carry 5 April. The Commission's own figure for its appeals is 16,10,311.
quote: The Commission has appealed against 49.4% of the cleared voters in the records, almost exactly half of everyone the judges found eligible.
